agent_hints.ads: Subject vehicle is an automated driving system program: its own motion is the system's.
agent_hints.driver_or_system: Level 2 driver assistance: NHTSA data cannot separate the human driver from the system.

disclaimer: Inferred, not a finding of fault. NHTSA's Standing General Order data records no fault. Each label is a rules-based inference from the structured fields of one report (pre-crash movements, contact areas, crash partner, speed), with the evidence basis and a confidence. Level 2 driver-assist programs cannot separate the human driver from the system in NHTSA data, so their own-motion label does not say which.

labels.label: other_party
labels.meaning: The structured fields point to another party's action (for example struck from behind).

labels.label: subject_vehicle_initiated
labels.meaning: The structured fields point to the subject vehicle's own motion starting the contact.

labels.label: indeterminate
labels.meaning: The structured fields do not support an inference.

rules.description: SV stopped or parked, with any known SV contact area, and the crash partner is another road user (not a fixed object, pole, tree or animal): the other party moved into it.
rules.label: other_party

rules.description: SV lane/road departure but contact only at the rear against another road user: the fields conflict, so no inference.
rules.label: indeterminate

rules.description: SV contact only at the rear (rear, rear left, rear right), the SV movement is known and not backing or a parking maneuver, and the crash partner is another road user: struck from behind.
rules.label: other_party

rules.description: SV contact only at the rear and a road-user partner, but the SV movement is unknown, other or a parking maneuver, so backing cannot be ruled out.
rules.label: other_party

rules.description: SV pre-crash movement is lane or road departure.
rules.label: subject_vehicle_initiated

rules.description: Crash with a fixed object, pole or tree, or an animal while the SV was moving (a moving movement, or speed above zero without a stopped or parked movement).
rules.label: subject_vehicle_initiated

rules.description: SV contact only at the front, the crash partner was stopped or parked, and the SV was moving.
rules.label: subject_vehicle_initiated

rules.description: The crash partner was maneuvering (lane change, turn, entering traffic, backing, wrong way, crossing the opposing lane, U-turn, merging, passing) while the SV went straight or was stopped, and the known SV contact is not front-only.
rules.label: other_party

rules.description: SV maneuver (lane change, turn, backing, merging, U-turn, entering traffic, passing) with front or side contact and a partner going straight, stopped or parked.
rules.label: subject_vehicle_initiated

rules.description: SV pre-crash movement or SV contact area is missing or unknown, so no rule can apply.
rules.label: indeterminate

rules.description: The fields are known but the combination matches none of the rules.
rules.label: indeterminate
